how_it_works.headline: What Happens When You Contact Us

steps.title: You reach out.
steps.text: Call, or send a short note. Tell us the county and what showed up in your mailbox.

steps.title: We look at the record.
steps.text: We pull what the public record shows about your tract and your ownership.

steps.title: We report back in plain language.
steps.text: You get a clear picture of what you own, what the document says, and where the risk sits.

steps.title: You decide the next step, with us.
steps.text: If the work calls for more, we will tell you. Either way you are talking to Petro Land Ventures.

short_form.headline: Send us a short note
short_form.intro: Four things is enough to start. Tell us what showed up and where the land sits.
short_form.what_label: What showed up (a lease offer, a division order, a letter, a question)
